spec.hypothesis: Observed within-name drift can arise from individual outside prototypes, inherited native content in transported coordinates, or rotary/key coupling. Compare these stages on the same saved original and physical-parent states.
spec.scope: Existing68 histories and1614positions. Conditional prefix-only attention is checked against recorded full attention before interpreting its mechanism.
spec.formula: pure=alpha*prefix_mean*Pmu*B.T; carried=incoming23*U; difference=carried-pure. This difference measures inherited content and accumulated numerical error; it is not assumed to be zero.

interpretation_limit: Labels and local attention probabilities are mechanistic diagnostics on supplied or recorded histories, not new generated answers. No native-content removal or selector repair is applied.
